title: Epstein prison cell video metadata edited
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Epstein prison cell video metadata edited, about 2019; reported 2025 at Metropolitan Correctional Center, New York, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Wired magazine, a fairly conventional [music]
tech publication, just revealed that the
metadata from Jeffrey Epstein's prison
cell video [music] that was supposed to
point to a suicide had been edited,
likely using Adobe Premiere.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Wired, a mainstream technology magazine, reported in 2025 that the metadata, the hidden technical record stored inside a file, of the video from Jeffrey Epstein's prison cell at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in New York in 2019 had been edited, likely with the video editing program Adobe Premiere. The video was supposed to point to Epstein's death being a suicide, so if the report is right, the footage may have been altered.
